name: claude-mods
description: Claude Code mods for working in git worktrees: a terminal and a file tree for the worktree a conversation works in

plugins.name: worktree-terminal
plugins.description: /terminal: show or open a Terminal-panel tab in the conversation's git worktree (Claude desktop app)

plugins.name: worktree-files
plugins.description: /worktree-files: open the filetree pane on the conversation's git worktree
